disclaimer: Fictional demonstration match using real club names and fictional player labels. Not an actual fixture, current roster, or official Premier League data.

documentation.replay: Emit events in sequence order. Wait (current.match_time_seconds - previous.match_time_seconds)/playback_speed seconds. Half-time break is omitted. Events sharing a timestamp retain sequence order.
documentation.coordinates: 0–100; x increases toward the acting team attacking goal; y is across pitch. Opposing-team coordinates rotate both axes. Pitch assumed 105 x 68 metres.
documentation.clock: Elapsed match seconds, excluding halftime interval. Use period to distinguish boundary events at 45:00.
documentation.difficulty_rating: Illustrative heuristic, not a trained model: min(0.8, 0.10 + distance_m/100 + 0.15 during scripted high-pressure window). Not a calibrated completion probability.
documentation.synthetic_xg: Illustrative synthetic value, not a validated expected-goals model.
documentation.speed: Sampled synthetic speeds, not measured or derived from tracking. No continuous tracking, player distance or possession-time estimates are supplied.
documentation.shot_count: Goals are shot events with outcome=goal; do not count them twice.
documentation.possession_id: Identifies current possession sequence; defensive pressure and tackle events reference the possession being challenged. New possession begins at possession_change or kickoff.
documentation.limitations: Simplified 90-minute simulation: no substitutions, fouls, cards, offsides, corners, stoppage time or injuries. Shot-end possession is simplified. Suitable for UI and streaming demos, not statistical benchmarking.
documentation.summary_usage: final_statistics is computed from all events. Hide it during replay and aggregate only events already emitted to avoid future-data leakage.
